limits.counts: No length limit is stated for regular research articles.
limits.notes: Both limits are approximate on the page: 'Title (~120 characters)', and text abstracts of '~250 words', in English, where 'Citations are not permitted.' No main-text, figure, legend, Methods, reference or keyword limit is stated for regular research or Large-Scale Biology articles; the page only says 'Be concise.' For comparison, 'Breakthrough Reports are limited to about 12 printed pages, 5 figures/tables'. Main tables 'should be a maximum of 1-2 pages long', and longer ones go in Excel Supplementary Data Sets. Supplementary figures and tables are combined 'into a single PDF (10 MB max)'. Required order: Title page, Abstract, Introduction, Materials and methods, Results, Discussion, Author contributions/Acknowledgment, Supplementary Material, Funding, Conflicts of interest, Data availability statement, References, Figure legends and Alt text for accessibility, Figures, Tables. 'All manuscripts must include' an unnumbered footnote naming 'The author(s) responsible for distribution of materials integral to the findings presented in this article'. Every figure needs alt text, placed under its legend and preceded by 'Alt text:'. The page asks authors for no other summary (no 'In a Nutshell' or one-sentence summary appeared).
